quote: the sender observes a target item and generates a message to describe it.
The sender transforms the input representation of the target item into an embedding and then generates one or more tokens, using e.g. a recurrent network. This sequence of tokens is called a message.
datasets: Custom dataset of 4-positional grids with two entities
outputs: Token sequences (messages) in an emergent vocabulary
